hypothesis: Isotonic calibration helps under proper 5-fold CV and the correct sign convention (brier_delta = candidate - baseline; negative = better).
method: sklearn.isotonic per-class one-vs-rest, 5-fold CV, paired bootstrap
original_error_explained: h-003 (1) computed brier_delta = baseline - candidate so a +0.214 value was waved through under 'higher=better' even though Brier is lower=better, and (2) fit isotonic on all 29 graded predictions and evaluated Brier on those same 29 — pure in-sample fit. h-012 fixes both: signed delta = candidate - baseline, and 5-fold cross-validated Brier where every held-out match is scored by an isotonic model trained without it.
sign_convention: delta = brier_calibrated - brier_baseline; negative=better; real_lift_brier = ci_95[1] < 0
source: wc2026_actuals.json (verified scores) joined to wc2026_model_predictions.json all_fixture_predictions; actuals resolved via scripts.wc2026_db.actual_for; isotonic fit via sklearn.isotonic.IsotonicRegression one-vs-rest per class with post-fit row renormalisation; 5-fold KFold(shuffle=True, random_state=20260619); paired bootstrap with 5000 reps.
